description: Parking lots equipped with electric vehicle charging stations is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. Location of electric vehicle charging stations in the city of Bologna. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Trasporti. Its keywords are Mobility of people and goods, Infrastructures, Urban and neighborhood planning. The portal shows 129 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
